haiku-low.q1: It still signs in the same account. Google accounts are matched by sub, not email, so the changed address does not matter. start_session runs and the user goes to the next path or /home.
haiku-low.q2: The user must enter that account's password on the confirm page. If it is correct, no other Google is linked, and the sub is still unlinked, the link is inserted and start_session runs.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password shows Incorrect password and adds 1 to failed_logins, and the pending link is kept. On the fifth, the account locks for 15 minutes, failed_logins resets to 0, and the pending link is deleted.
haiku-low.q4: Verified email with no matching user: create a user with no password and verified email, insert the user_identities row, then start_session. Unverified email: refuse on the start page, pointing to email and password; nothing is created.
haiku-low.q5: Both get an error page and nothing changes. The attempt expires after 10 minutes, and each attempt is deleted when first read, so a repeated callback finds nothing.
haiku-low.q6: It creates a sessions row and sets the sid cookie through start_session, the same as password login. NOT STATED for what happens to a sid cookie the browser already has.
haiku-low.q7: No password or email match is required, only a signed-in session. If the sub is linked to another user, Settings shows a refusal message and nothing changes.
haiku-low.q8: In Redis under oidc:attempt:<state>, for 10 minutes. The callback deletes it when it reads it once, and otherwise it expires after 10 minutes.
haiku-low.q9: Held in Redis as oidc:pending:<id> with user id, sub, email and next path. The browser refers to it by the oidc_pending cookie. It is deleted on success, on a lock, or on expiry after 10 minutes.
haiku-low.q10: In the Postgres user_identities table. Its unique google_sub and unique user_id columns enforce one user per Google account and one Google account per user.
haiku-low.q11: The user sees an error page and nothing changes. The attempt is already deleted, so the user starts again. The document does not describe any retry of the exchange.
haiku-low.q12: The attempt stores its purpose, login or link. For link it also stores the signed-in user id. The callback finds the attempt by state, and for a link it checks the session still belongs to that user.

sonnet.q1: Matching uses sub, so the linked user still reaches the same account; the sub is in user_identities, so start_session is called for that user and they are redirected to the saved next path or /home.
sonnet.q2: A pending link is saved (10 min) and the user is sent to the confirm password page; they must submit the correct password for that account (account not locked, no other Google linked, sub still unlinked). Only then is the identity inserted and start_session called. No session before that.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins and shows 'Incorrect password.' with the pending link kept. On the fifth wrong password the account is locked for 15 minutes (locked_until), failed_logins is reset to 0, the pending link is deleted, and 'Account temporarily locked.' is shown. Nothing is linked.
sonnet.q4: Verified email matching no user: create a user with password_hash NULL and email_verified_at set to now, insert the user_identities row, then start_session. If email_verified is false: refuse with a message on the start page pointing to email and password; nothing is created.
sonnet.q5: Error page and nothing changes. After 12 minutes the attempt (10-minute TTL) has expired; a second load finds the state already used/deleted. Both are 'unknown, expired or used state'.
sonnet.q6: The same session as a password login: start_session creates a sessions row and sets the sid cookie. NOT STATED what happens to a sid cookie the browser already had.
sonnet.q7: No password and no email match is required, and email_verified is not needed; matching is by sub only. If the sub is already linked to another user (or this user has a different Google account), it is refused with a message in Settings and nothing changes.
sonnet.q8: In a Redis attempt record at oidc:attempt:<state> (holding state, nonce, PKCE verifier, purpose, next path or user id), found by the state in the redirect, not a cookie. The callback deletes it when it reads it (single use); otherwise it expires after 10 minutes.
sonnet.q9: In a Redis pending link at oidc:pending:<id> holding user id, sub, email and next path. The browser refers to it by the oidc_pending=<id> cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax). It is deleted on success, on a lock (locked account or fifth wrong password), on a link conflict, or by expiry after 10 minutes.
sonnet.q10: In the Postgres table user_identities(google_sub UNIQUE, user_id UNIQUE, created_at). The two UNIQUE columns enforce one user per Google account and one Google account per user.
sonnet.q11: The user sees an error page and nothing changes. The exchange is not retried; the attempt is already deleted so the user must start again. An invalid ID token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) also gives an error page.
sonnet.q12: By the purpose field (login or link) stored in the Redis attempt. For link, the attempt stores the signed-in user id, and the callback checks the current session still belongs to that user; if not, it shows an error page and changes nothing.
